forum.overflow_a11y_label: {count, plural, one {Show # more participant} other {Show # more participants}}
forum.load_failed: Could not load the participant list.

admin.strip_size_help: How many avatars appear on a discussion row before the rest become an overflow badge.
admin.placement_help: On its own line the strip sits under the discussion title. Inline keeps rows one line tall by putting it beside the reply count.
admin.placement_below: On its own line, under the title
admin.avatar_size_help: How large the avatars in the strip are.
admin.order_help: Which participants earn the visible places, and in what order they are stacked.
admin.include_op_label: The person who started the discussion
admin.include_op_help: Their avatar is already shown in the author column, so by default the strip leaves them out.
admin.include_op_never: Never show them in the strip
admin.include_op_if_replied: Show them only if they replied as well
admin.min_participants_help: Discussions with fewer repliers than this get no strip at all, which keeps quiet lists clean.
admin.show_overflow_help: The badge counts participants the strip has no room for, and opens the full list when clicked.
admin.hover_cards_label: Show a profile card on hover
admin.hover_cards_help: Hovering an avatar reveals the same profile card Flarum shows on post authors.
admin.tags_help: Choose the tags that should show a strip. With none chosen it appears everywhere.
admin.tags_empty: This forum has no tags yet.
admin.rebuild_help: Discussions that existed before this extension was enabled have no participant data until it is built. This does the same job as the participants:populate command.
admin.rebuild_done: {count, plural, one {Done — # participant record.} other {Done — # participant records.}}
admin.rebuild_failed: The recalculation failed. Check your server logs, or run participants:populate instead.
